description: Semantic search over the company knowledge graph: the facts the query is about, the links between their entities and what was left out. Apply asOf for historical "what was true on X" queries. Embedding model on this tenant: set per workspace.

asOf.description: Valid-time as-of: facts true at this ISO 8601 moment (a retraction dated before it hides the fact; a fact learned after it still shows — not a knowledge snapshot)

detail.description: focus (default): only what the query is about, as facts or the source turn, whichever is shorter. compact: every fact of the matched entities, with entity ids. full: adds ids, scores, trust keys

userId.description: Whose memory: this user's personal facts beside the tenant-global ones; omit for tenant-global only

name: search_knowledge
title: Search company knowledge
